info.name: B3 Data API - Multi-Chain Data API

description.content:
Cached proxy layer for multiple blockchain APIs with 24-hour caching and automatic fallback across chains. Supports both Blockscout and ThirdWeb Insights APIs. Add ?mintlify parameter for Mintlify-compatible version.

Contact Support:
 Name: B3 Team
